steps.note: A bad manifest value is reported at the manifest line.
The owned-key finding names the manifest and collection.
A manifest entry naming an unloaded page is exit 2.
A write to a manifest-owned key lands in the manifest.
A field-joined manifest flags a duplicate id on both pages.
A field entry no page carries is exit 2.
An UPDATE of the join field is refused, exit 2.
